description: Tsunami modelling along the east Queensland coast - Moreton Bay is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation. Water level rasters (m AHD), depth rasters (m), current speed (m/s), direction (degrees) and flood extent polygons for the Queensland coast have been translated from there associated water level raster (averaged to 0. 01cm). This dataset is approximately 2. 5 GB in size. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation. It offers 2 resource(s) in spatial data format, xml. The portal shows 2025-06-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
